parse_json_to_protobuf_message: parse a JSON string into a protobuf message using json_format.Parse with a target message object
convert_protobuf_message_to_json: convert a protobuf message to a JSON string using json_format.MessageToJson with optional formatting flags
parse_dict_to_protobuf_message: parse a Python dictionary into a protobuf message using json_format.ParseDict with a target message object
convert_protobuf_message_to_dict: convert a protobuf message to a Python dictionary using json_format.MessageToDict for programmatic access
test_protobuf_json_roundtrip: test that a protobuf message serializes to JSON and parses back to an equal message using CheckParseBack
